capabilities: Paste and drop images as inline data instead of attachment files
Collapse inline image data visually to keep the editor readable
Convert image embeds and online image links into inline images
Export inline images back to the vault as normal files
Batch-convert or batch-export images across a note, folder, or vault
extras: Works on mobile and desktop; conversion and export actions are designed around png, jpg, and jpeg embeds only.
problem: Obsidian turns every pasted or dropped image into a separate attachment file, cluttering the vault and breaking self-contained notes.
summary: Inline-image plugin that pastes and drops images into notes as inline data instead of creating attachment files.
